This is a locum doctor role for a Emergency Medicine Consultant at Cessnock in NSW.

### Role Info

Monday, 27 July 2026	0800-2000	12hrs	 $3,500.00 

Monday, 27 July 2026	2000-0800	12hrs	 $3,000.00 

Wednesday, 29 July 2026	2200-0800	10hrs	 $3,000.00 

Saturday, 1 August 2026	2300-0900	10hrs	 $3,000.00 

Sunday, 2 August 2026	2300-0900	10hrs	 $3,000.00 



SDPR training completion required prior to commencing, please ensure locum is committed to completing the 6hrs for training required before commencing these shifts. Doctors are paid for this time.



Accommodation provided and travel up to $800 reimbursed (flights or mileage only).

			

An exciting opportunity exists for a CMO IC or GP VMO to join the Emergency Department at Cessnock Hospital, a well-established district hospital providing 24/7 emergency care and comprehensive inpatient services to the local community. Currently undergoing a major redevelopment, the hospital offers modernising facilities, strong multidisciplinary support and the chance to practise high-quality medicine with genuine clinical autonomy in a collaborative regional setting.



Located in the heart of the picturesque Hunter Valley, Cessnock offers an enviable lifestyle with renowned wineries, restaurants and affordable living. The hospital is approximately 45–50 minutes’ drive from Newcastle and around 2 hours from Sydney, providing easy access to major city amenities and airports while enjoying the benefits of a vibrant regional community.
